display_long_description:
Browse with more privacy and security. All it takes is a single click. NordVPN changes your IP address, encrypts your traffic, and enables you to enjoy the true freedom of the internet. 

Why NordVPN? 

**Super speeds**

NordVPN consistently ranks as one of the fastest VPNs on the market, often reaching the very top. Plus, NordVPN’s global server network and groundbreaking protocols ensure the best speeds without compromising on security.    

**Protect 10 devices with one account**

With a single NordVPN account, you can have simultaneous connections on 10 devices. We have apps for every platform, so you can enjoy security wherever you are. 

**Easy setup** 

NordVPN is incredibly easy to use. Simply download the app, get a NordVPN subscription if you don’t have one yet, and login — that’s it. Let the app find the best server for you and connect automatically, helping you stay protected at all times. 

**Meshnet**

NordVPN’s free Meshnet feature can be used to connect dozens of devices into one secure network. Share files, collaborate on projects, or play together — all completely free. 

**Dark Web Monitor**

Scan the deep and the dark web for signs of your leaked credentials, get notified in real time, and protect your accounts before criminals can cause damage. 

**24/7 support**

If your internet connection is acting up or even if you have a simple question about NordVPN, don’t hesitate to contact our customer support team, available around the clock.
